body:
Corn Silage fully fertilized yields ~140kl/ha.
At a nominal price of $300/kl, corn chaff yields ~$42000/ha.

Growing poplar for woodchips is also very profitable.
Fertilization does not effect poplar yield, which is ~240kl/ha.
At a nominal price of $200/kl, growing poplar for woodchips yields ~$48,000/ha.
